inputFieldOptions.label: Top P
inputFieldOptions.helpText: Nucleus sampling — limits choices to top percentage of likely tokens. Lower values make output more focused.

inputFieldOptions.label: Top K
inputFieldOptions.helpText: Limits the model's token choices at each step to the top K most likely tokens. 0 means disabled.

inputFieldOptions.label: Frequency Penalty
inputFieldOptions.helpText: Penalizes tokens based on how frequently they appear in the text so far. Positive values reduce repetition.

inputFieldOptions.label: Presence Penalty
inputFieldOptions.helpText: Penalizes tokens that have already appeared at all, regardless of frequency. Encourages new topics.

inputFieldOptions.label: Repetition Penalty
inputFieldOptions.helpText: General repetition reduction. Values above 1.0 penalize repeated tokens from the input. 1.0 means no penalty.

inputFieldOptions.label: Min P
inputFieldOptions.helpText: Minimum probability threshold relative to the most likely token. Tokens below this threshold are filtered out.

inputFieldOptions.label: Top A
inputFieldOptions.helpText: Filters tokens by probability relative to the maximum. Only tokens with sufficiently high probability are kept.

inputFieldOptions.label: Seed
inputFieldOptions.helpText: Set a fixed seed for deterministic/reproducible outputs. Same seed + same input = same output.

inputFieldOptions.label: Stop Sequences
inputFieldOptions.helpText: Comma-separated tokens that will cause the model to stop generating. Useful for controlling output boundaries.

inputFieldOptions.label: JSON Mode
inputFieldOptions.helpText: Force the model to output valid JSON. Useful when you need structured, parseable responses.
